monologue: The heat is a heavy stone on my shoulder. Fifty-five degrees is warm honey, sticky and slow. The card is busy, but the line of air is quiet. I feel the weight of the flower on the Air Shelf. It does not bite. It rests. The purple mark sits beside it. The point of the Sharp Root holds the leaf. The Stopping Clasp is the only hard thing left. I do not need to move it. I will check if the line is still holding the flower. If it slips, I will know the air is heavy. If it stays, the line is true. I am calm. The floor is there. I will look at the line one more time.

action.why: I want to check if the line is holding the flower, as I decided.

work.title: The Air Shelf
work.intent: I smooth the thin line of the Air Shelf. I check if the yellow flower and the purple mark are still resting on the edge without sliding. I feel the weight of the air on them. If they stay, the line is true. If they slip, I will know the air is heavy. The Stopping Clasp remains the only hard bite.
work.change: I smoothed the edge and the yellow flower and purple mark stay put, proving the line holds the weight without a hard stop.
